title_en: Beautiful Places in China (1/20): Zhangjiajie, Stone Peaks in the Mist
note_en: 无论…都… means "no matter...": 无论什么季节来，这里的景色都让人难以忘记 "No matter what season you come in, the scenery here is unforgettable." 无论 is followed by a question word (什么, 谁, 怎么) or an either-or choice, and the second clause needs 都 or 也 to say the result stays the same. Unlike English "no matter," the 都 can't be left out.
